fusions.name: Fowler's Blunt
fusions.desc: Looses a blunt-headed arrow that deals 5 damage to the first enemy in its path, with a 30% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Loosed at Full Draw
fusions.desc: Draws the hammer back and throws it at a target up to 9 tiles away for 28 damage, rising to 2.2 times that at full reach. It always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Lengthened Haft
fusions.desc: After a 1-second cast, your attacks and spells reach 54% further for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: String Pulled Taut
fusions.desc: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your critical chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.
